{-# LANGUAGE ScopedTypeVariables #-}
module Main (main) where

import qualified Data.Map as Map
import Data.List (foldl')

{- outer {- nested -} still a comment -}
data Shape = Circle Double | Rect Double Double
  deriving (Show, Eq)

area :: Shape -> Double
area (Circle r) = pi * r ^ 2
area (Rect w h) = w * h

sumAll :: [Int] -> Int
sumAll xs = foldl' (+) 0 xs

main :: IO ()
main = do
  let x' = 0x1F + 1_000 + 3.14e-2
      c = 'a'
      nl = '\n'
      name = 'Circle
  putStrLn ("Hello, " ++ show (area (Circle 1.5)) ++ "\t\x41")
  mapM_ print [Just 1, Nothing]
  if x' > 0 && not (null "abc") then return () else error "never"
